description: Changes the community module (users publish entries with neblla.community): open or reviewed publishing, who publishes, categories, limits, report threshold, votes, an AI prescreen paid with the developer's Claude key. Needs neblla_update_app features { community: true }. Waits in the draft until neblla_promote "save" (env "pro" for the users). More: neblla_get_llms tools/update_app_community

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

community.description: The fields to change, merged: { mode: open | review | closed, whoPublishes: users | moderators, categories, maxEntriesPerUser, prescreen, … }.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

name: neblla_update_app_community
title: Change community settings
